title: Kimi K3 Celebration Banquet Pictures Emerge: Moonshot's Beijing Nightclub Shouts 'Launch to the Moon', K4 Is on Its Way
excerpt: Recently, a netizen revealed an amusing story on Xiaohongshu - the moon's dark side held a celebration and team-building event at a bar in Beijing last Friday,
content_html:
Recently, a netizen revealed an amusing story on Xiaohongshu - the moon's dark side held a celebration and team-building event at a bar in Beijing last Friday, officially celebrating the high industry attention and market response after the official release of its Kimi K3 large model. In the footage and text that surfaced, the big screen displayed the team's subsequent product planning slogan: this generation of K3 is positioned as an expanded and upgraded version, while the next generation K4 will be refined to the ultimate level. An ambitious slogan "reach for the moon" was directly shouted on stage.

The co-founder and president of Moon's Dark Side, Zhang Yuting, was also present at this celebration. A netizen shared a small anecdote: he tried to add a staff member as a friend on site, but was politely refused by the Kimi team. Although it was lively, the door remained tightly guarded.

Returning our focus to the product itself. Kimi K3 was officially launched this month on the 16th, and is the most powerful large model released by Moon's Dark Side so far. It has 2.8 trillion parameters and supports an ultra-long context window of 1 million tokens, focusing on ultra-long code writing and full-chain knowledge office scenarios. As soon as it was unveiled, it caused a sensation in both domestic and international AI circles, with top-tier comprehensive performance placing it in the global top tier, and front-end programming capabilities even securing the top spot globally.

Its strong performance also stirred up public opinion. Due to the impact of Kimi K3, discussions about Kimi K3, its founder Yang Zhilin, and the overall development of Chinese large models on the X platform have continued to spread, with views quickly exceeding ten million and discussions expanding from niche technical communities to the general public. A night club celebration reflects the company's step from the technology circle to the public eye.

content_html_zh:
近日，有网友在小红书上爆出了一个趣事——月之暗面上周五在北京一家酒吧举办了庆祝暨团建活动，正式庆祝旗下Kimi K3大机型正式发布后获得的业界高度关注和市场反响。 浮出水面的画面和文字中，大屏幕上显示着团队后续的产品规划口号：这一代K3定位为扩展升级版，而下一代K4则将精雕细琢到极致。 舞台上直接喊出了“登月”的雄心勃勃的口号。

月之暗面联合创始人兼总裁张宇廷也出席了本次庆典。 有网友分享了一个小轶事：他试图在现场加一位工作人员为好友，但被Kimi团队礼貌地拒绝了。 虽然很热闹，但门口还是守得严严实实的。

让我们的注意力回到产品本身。 Kimi K3于本月16日正式上市，是Moon’s Dark Side迄今为止发布的最强大的大型机型。 拥有2.8万亿参数，支持100万代币超长上下文窗口，专注于超长代码编写和全链知识办公场景。 它一经亮相，就引起了国内外人工智能界的轰动，顶级的综合性能跻身全球顶尖水平，前端编程能力更是坐稳全球第一。

其强劲的表现也激起了舆论。 受《Kimi K3》的影响，X平台上有关《Kimi K3》及其创始人杨志林以及中国大型车型整体发展的讨论不断蔓延，浏览量迅速破千万，讨论从小众技术社区拓展到普通大众。 一场夜店庆典，体现了公司从科技圈走向公众视野的一步。
